# Apex & Axis
> Apex & Axis is a business architecture firm for solo operators. The firm diagnoses and treats Founder-Dependency Syndrome, a structural condition where demand generation, sales conversion, delivery, decision-making, and growth remain locked inside the founder's calendar and memory.

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://apexandaxis.org/): Primary conversion page for Apex & Axis, including the Founder-Dependency Syndrome diagnosis, four-engine operating model, Axis Audit, Axis Starter Kit, and Apex Vault.
- [About Apex & Axis](https://apexandaxis.org/about.html): Static overview of the firm, founder attribution, positioning, and operating methodology.
- [Axis Starter Kit](https://whop.com/joined/apex-axis/products/axis-starter-kit/): Free entry tier containing the Axis Audit, Content Multiplier, Axis Protocol, and Architect's Stack.
- [Apex Vault](https://whop.com/joined/apex-axis/products/apex-vault-blueprint/): Paid vault containing the complete four-engine operating framework and Operator's Guide.

## Concepts
- Founder-Dependency Syndrome: A structural operating failure where the business collapses when the founder stops working.
- Marketing Engine: Governs demand and authority.
- Sales Engine: Governs qualification, conversion, and settlement.
- Operations Engine: Governs documented workflows, delegation, and delivery systems.
- Growth Engine: Governs constraints, capacity, ascension paths, and expansion beyond founder-led delivery.
